AI summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned abruptly, said on X that he would be "honoured" to return if the board decides it is in the best interest of shareholders, employees, the company and America, after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy. The board is reportedly not considering his return and is investigating his conduct, including an alleged affair with an Nvidia executive, while interim CEO Colette Kress may address the situation when Nvidia reports its financial results. For someone following NVDA, the leadership uncertainty, the internal investigation, and the planned US congressional questioning of Huang all bear on the company's governance and near-term direction.
